answer: A farm needs 141 distinct hands, since the ratios depend on bone structure and cannot be copied. A fresh hand scan is matched to the enrolled geometry each epoch. The grove is the wall and the velvet is the gate: Finger lengths and palm width form a hand-geometry measurement unique enough to tell people apart. A farm of 141 aliases must climb the wall 141 times, the kernel ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
